subject: Learning Methods
title: SMART Goals for Learning
description: A micro-lesson that makes SMART Goals for Learning usable.

hook.text: She said 'I want to learn Spanish.' A year later, nothing changed. She never defined what 'learn Spanish' meant.

buildup.text: SMART goals are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. They convert wishes into actionable targets.

discovery.text: SMART Goals for Learning reveals the principle that makes the learning stick.

twist.text: Goals that are too easy don't motivate. Goals that are impossible demoralize.

climax.text: Rewrite your learning goal: 'Complete chapters 1 to 3 of biology by Friday with 80 % quiz accuracy.' Now it is SMART.

punchline.text: Specific. Measurable. Time-bound. Now it is a real goal.

quiz.question: Why are specific, challenging goals better than vague intentions?
options: They require less effort to achieve
They increase performance by 20-25 percent by making targets actionable
They eliminate the need for motivation
